purpose: Verify unsupported Condition operator (StringNotEquals) produces POLICY_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE error output with exitCode 3.
notes: This case represents the unsupported feature error output path. StringNotEquals is not in the supported operators list (StringEquals/StringLike/Bool/IpAddress). The golden output is an error structure, not a full EvaluationResult. Prior to D03 golden generation, NotAction was used but rejected by zod as POLICY_INVALID_SHAPE (exitCode 2).
